title: image block props
description: An image from the assets folder.
x-ai-instructions: Only images with an instructional function (E1). Write alt as the information the image carries, not its file name. Mark purely decorative images decorative: true. Generated images must be marked generated: true (AI Act art. 50).

alt.description: Text alternative. Required unless decorative is true.

decorative.description: True only if the image carries no information.

generated.description: True if produced by an AI model; the player shows a mark and the build report lists it.

inline.description: SVG only: the drawing goes into the page instead of an , so that the draw effect of a timing traces its strokes and the theme's CSS and currentColor reach its shapes. Sanitized when it is built: no script, no event handler, no link or reference out of the drawing; its ids prefixed with the block's, its own
